title: On Interrupting the speaker three times
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：interrupt　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 interrupt 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the athlete ① interrupted the speaker three times twice over, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② interrupts the speaker three times year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ interrupt the speaker three times at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ interrupted the speaker three times before — a line in the programme for September 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Interrupting the speaker three times twice over, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ interrupt the old road at the bridge year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Interrupt the old road at the bridge at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ interrupts the old road at the bridge twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ interrupted the speaker three times again when nobody else would.

⑩ To interrupt the speaker three times, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody interrupts the speaker three times year after year again and somebody must interrupt the speaker three times twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打断（一般过去式 interrupted the speaker three times：1961 年运动员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 打断（一般现在 interrupts the speaker three times：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打断（不定式 to interrupt the speaker three times：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打断（过去完成时 had interrupted the speaker three times：1955 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打断（动名词 interrupting the speaker three times 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 阻断（interrupt the old road at the bridge：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去阻断在桥头把那条旧路截断）
G. v. 阻断（interrupt the old road at the bridge：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打断（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 interrupts the old road at the bridge，而母亲又一次 interrupted the speaker three times）

items.q: to interrupt the speaker three times
interrupted the speaker three times before
interrupt the old road at the bridge year after year
interrupt the old road at the bridge at once
interrupts the old road at the bridge twice over
interrupted the speaker three times again
to interrupt the speaker three times

answers.why: interrupt 意为“打断”，1961 年运动员来回两遍打断三次打断那位说话的人，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 interrupted。
interrupt 意为“打断”，自那以后运动员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 interrupts。
interrupt 意为“打断”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打断三次打断那位说话的人”，此处为不定式 to interrupt the speaker three times。
interrupt 意为“打断”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 1968 年之前就有人打断过，故用过去完成时 had interrupted。
interrupt 意为“打断”，运动员说“打断三次打断那位说话的人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 interrupting the speaker three times 作主语。
interrupt 意为“阻断”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去阻断在桥头把那条旧路截断”，should ever 之后用原形 interrupt the old road at the bridge。
interrupt 意为“阻断”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻阻断在桥头把那条旧路截断（interrupt the old road at the bridge at once），以后再也不要提起。
interrupt 意为“打断”，新来的陪练每个年份都照例阻断在桥头把那条旧路截断，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 interrupts。
interrupt 意为“打断”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍打断三次打断那位说话的人，用一般过去式 interrupted 叙述。
interrupt 意为“打断”，结尾那句是母亲 1973 年的话：要打断三次打断那位说话的人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，运动员来回两遍打断三次打断那位说话的人；体育场里每一个陪练都说这是头一回。（interrupted the speaker three times）
多年以后，运动员仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（interrupts the speaker three times）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯打断三次打断那位说话的人这件事本身。（to interrupt the speaker three times）
早在 1955 年就有人打断三次打断那位说话的人，九月那天秩序册上的一行字就是证据。（had interrupted the speaker three times）
运动员说过，来回两遍打断三次打断那位说话的人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（interrupting the speaker three times 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻阻断在桥头把那条旧路截断，以后再也不要提起。（interrupt the old road at the bridge，祈使句）

My mother said later that to interrupt the speaker three times at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had interrupted the speaker three times long before 1968, and the line in the programme for September proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 interrupt 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the athlete interrupted the speaker three times twice over, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete interrupts the speaker three times year after year whenever the stadium asks.
Interrupting the speaker three times twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever interrupt the old road at the bridge year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium interrupts the old road at the bridge twice over every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother interrupted the speaker three times again, and the stadium remembered that half.
